description: This file defines interfaces, data structures, and constants related to User Equipment (UE) management in the MAC layer of a 5G/4G radio system, including creation, reconfiguration, deletion, and radio link failure notifications.

classes.name: mac_ue_radio_link_notifier
classes.description: Interface for notifying radio link failures and C-RNTI change events for a UE.

classes.name: mac_ue_configurator
classes.description: Interface for managing creation, reconfiguration, and deletion of UEs in MAC.

methods.name: handle_ue_create_request
methods.description: Creates a UE context in the MAC asynchronously.

methods.name: handle_ue_reconfiguration_request
methods.description: Reconfigures an existing UE context in the MAC asynchronously.

methods.name: handle_ue_delete_request
methods.description: Deletes a UE context in the MAC asynchronously.

methods.name: handle_ul_ccch_msg
methods.description: Forwards UL-CCCH message to upper layers.

methods.name: handle_ue_config_applied
methods.description: Handles confirmation that UE received last RRC configuration.
